description: Brought the cloves and the soft middle of the loaf.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Saw the three sockets, priced the meal, and saved the count.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said a gathering tooth comes to a head at the full moon.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Took the cloves, separated them from the sixpence, and asked for one candle.
name: William Shakespeare
